# About

TabloStyle Galleri (also known as Tablo Style Gallery) is an online wall art store operating from Sheki (Şəki), Azerbaijan, delivering across the entire country.
The catalog features over 200 designs indexed as TS-GAL-001 through TS-GAL-202, alongside custom photo printing and custom-sized wall paintings for homes, offices, cafes, hotels, and gifts.

---

# Delivery Terms & Shipping Costs (Azərbaycan)

## 1. Azərpoçt (All Regions of Azerbaijan)
- Coverage: All cities, districts, and villages across Azerbaijan.
- Shipping Fee: 3–10 AZN (manat), depending on artwork size and dimensions.

## 2. Bus Delivery from Sheki (Avtobus ilə çatdırılma)
- Shipping Fee: 5 AZN (manat).
- Covered Cities & Districts: Balakən, Zaqatala, Qax, Mingəçevir, Bərdə, Gəncə, Yevlax, Oğuz, Qəbələ, İsmayıllı, Şamaxı, Bakı, Sumqayıt, Ucar, Kürdəmir, Qobustan, Göyçay.
